item_short_desc: Rothco's One-Hole Face Mask is your go-to choice for extreme cold weather coverage. Crafted from double-layer acrylic knit fabric, the face covering provides unparalleled warmth and protection against freezing temperatures and wind. The single hole opening allows for full or partial face coverage, catering to your comfort needs. Ideal for avid outdoorsmen, hunters, skiers, and snowboarders, this face mask is made in the USA and designed to fit most head sizes.
